custodyProfile.uncertainty: Statutory liability segregation applies between sub-funds, with an explicit foreign-court enforcement caveat. Standard Chartered Trustee provides fund custody; Standard Chartered Bank provides administration, token custody and the authoritative off-chain register. Distributors hold omnibus tokens and separate end-investor records. Current asset custody allocation and distributor protections do not establish a whole-book institutional tier.
